nodes.label: Amazon SDE-I Tailored CV
nodes.rationale: Led with concurrency, algorithms, and databases instead of recommendation/sequence models to match the Amazon SDE posting's keywords; dropped the math-tutor work entry to make room for a fourth project on one page; header retitled 'Software Engineer | Data Science M.Sc. Student'; forecasting research reworded as 'modular framework across a distributed compute cluster' to surface the posting's scalable/distributed-computing language.
